[LNAM.1.3] Unicode identifiers need no per-source selector, because the
artefact's version series already gates the boundary whole ([LDET.1.10]): a
runtime reads only what its own series wrote, so a `use`-declaration pin
would gate per file what is already gated per artefact. The version pin
interacts with the pinned Unicode version ([LNAM.2.2.5]).

The feature is unconditional within a series, which is why every ASCII
identifier remains legal ([LNAM.2.2.2]) and why `NAME` is defined over the
full XID class with no further condition ([LGRA.2.5.1], [LNAM.2.2.1]).
